content: {"like":["Enjoys sci‑fi action with reality‑manipulation themes like The Matrix","Prefers dark, atmospheric nighttime settings","Values strong visual design in creature‑heavy animated shorts","Appreciates high‑quality cinematography in indie dramas","Enjoys films that inspire other media, e.g., Back to the Future"],"dislike":["Dislikes loud, distracting audience noise in live performances","Avoids poorly mixed sound that obscures dialogue","Rejects thin, unengaging plots in short‑form animation","Dislikes films that feel like low‑budget comedy attempts","Prefers not to watch movies with overly simplistic or violent content for young viewers"]}
